Reissue leaves all three errors standing and adds a second contract; a sidecar registers nothing under the validator's glob and, if forced to register, creates two sources of truth for one frozen contract that collide as a duplicate id the moment the original is repaired.

THE COST IS STATED, NOT GLOSSED. Repairing experiments/EXP-STR-003/specification.yaml changes its blob. After the repair, HEAD's file is no longer byte-identical to the attested freeze at 92268c9e. What remains true, and what the correction record must say, is that the original blob is preserved permanently by Git at 92268c9e and c79e3a8d, that the 20 run manifests attest a COMMIT rather than a working-tree file and continue to resolve to the original blob, and that the pre-registration ordering that makes the ablation evidential is a property of commit order that no later edit can alter.
